summary.headline: Pisces and the Arctic Pole
summary.text: Astrological description of Pisces, covering its qualities, effects on those born under it, stellar risings and settings, associated gods, adjacent winds, regions, seas, rivers, cities, and surrounding constellations and polar circles. The passage also describes the Bears at the arctic pole, including Cynosura.
